notes: Makeshift Battalion, printed: 'Battalion - Whenever this creature and at least two other creatures attack, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.' The Battalion (3/2) attacks together with two other creatures, three attackers in all: it gets one +1/+1 counter as the attackers are declared, so it deals 4. The unblocked attackers deal 4 + 2 + 2: the opponent goes from 20 to 12. The two others get no counter.
